title: Swedish

sourceText.admission:
Admission Requirements

Students in good academic standing may declare this major at any time.

sections.credentialOverview:
Credential Overview

By earning a B.A. in Swedish, a student acquires advanced linguistic proficiency in Swedish, excellent knowledge of Sweden in a broad perspective, as well as superb and practical communication skills.
sections.programCompletionRequirements:
Completion Requirements

60 credits

• First- and second-year courses in Swedish language (30 credits)

• Upper-division courses in Swedish language. See department for list of approved courses. (10 credits)

• Upper-division SCAND courses. See department for list of approved courses. (15 credits)

• SCAND 498 (5 credits)
